headline: CDC contiguous-recompute wins ALL 12 cells on BOTH metrics under real vLLM PagedAttention. TTFT PIC/CDC = 1.05-1.79x (CDC faster); throughput CDC/PIC = 1.00-1.13x (CDC higher). NO cell where PIC wins. Advantage is STRONGER at 28k ctx (TTFT up to 1.79x, throughput up to 1.13x at B=8).
limitation: lmcache NOT installed -> PIC arm is a faithful re-impl against vLLM PagedAttention (scatter realized as extra paged-gather traversal), NOT the published lmcache CacheBlend kernel. The non-contiguous paged KV layout (the committee's load-bearing concern) IS exercised (real vLLM PagedAttention).
